templates.title: Particle measurement table
templates.description: Threshold an 8- or 16-bit grayscale image within a chosen raw intensity window and measure every 8-connected particle in calibrated units.

image.label: Grayscale image (.pgm, .tif)
image.description: Absolute path to one 8- or 16-bit unsigned grayscale plane.

size.label: Pixel size
size.description: Width and height of one pixel in the selected unit (square pixels).

lower.label: Lowest foreground intensity
lower.description: Inclusive raw intensity; pixels at or above it (up to the upper bound) are particle pixels.

upper.label: Highest foreground intensity
upper.description: Inclusive raw intensity, at least the lower bound. Use at most 255 for 8-bit images or 65535 for 16-bit images.

templates.requires: Java 11+ with jdk.compiler and ImageJ 1.54 ij.jar for native execution.

templates.title: Filled particles away from edges
templates.description: Measure particles with interior holes filled, dropping particles that touch the image border and specks below 0.5 square units.

image.label: Grayscale image (.pgm, .tif)
image.description: Absolute path to one 8- or 16-bit unsigned grayscale plane.

size.label: Pixel size
size.description: Width and height of one pixel in the selected unit (square pixels).

lower.label: Lowest foreground intensity
lower.description: Inclusive raw intensity; pixels at or above it (up to the upper bound) are particle pixels.

upper.label: Highest foreground intensity
upper.description: Inclusive raw intensity, at least the lower bound. Use at most 255 for 8-bit images or 65535 for 16-bit images.

templates.requires: Java 11+ with jdk.compiler and ImageJ 1.54 ij.jar for native execution.

templates.title: Region measurements across two frames
templates.description: Measure one named rectangle in two captured grayscale frames with declared times and calibration: pixel count, calibrated area and raw mean/min/max per frame.

image1.label: First frame (.pgm, .tif)
image1.description: Absolute path to one captured 8- or 16-bit unsigned grayscale plane; every frame must share width, height and bit depth.

image2.label: Second frame (.pgm, .tif)
image2.description: Absolute path to one captured 8- or 16-bit unsigned grayscale plane; every frame must share width, height and bit depth.

time2.label: Second frame time (s)
time2.description: Declared seconds since the series origin; must exceed the previous frame time.

x.label: Rectangle left (x)
x.description: Zero-based left pixel column of the rectangle.

y.label: Rectangle top (y)
y.description: Zero-based top pixel row of the rectangle.

width.label: Rectangle width
width.description: Pixel columns included, at least 1; x + width must not exceed the image width.

height.label: Rectangle height
height.description: Pixel rows included, at least 1; y + height must not exceed the image height.

size.label: Pixel size
size.description: Width and height of one pixel in the selected unit (square pixels); edit the document for rectangular pixels.

templates.requires: Java 11+ with jdk.compiler and ImageJ 1.54 ij.jar for native execution.

templates.title: Whole frame and inner rectangle over three frames
templates.description: Measure the whole frame and an overlapping inner rectangle in three captured frames. The rectangles are independent measurements, not a partition.

image1.label: First frame (.pgm, .tif)
image1.description: Absolute path to one captured 8- or 16-bit unsigned grayscale plane; every frame must share width, height and bit depth.

image2.label: Second frame (.pgm, .tif)
image2.description: Absolute path to one captured 8- or 16-bit unsigned grayscale plane; every frame must share width, height and bit depth.

image3.label: Third frame (.pgm, .tif)
image3.description: Absolute path to one captured 8- or 16-bit unsigned grayscale plane; every frame must share width, height and bit depth.

time2.label: Second frame time (s)
time2.description: Declared seconds since the series origin; must exceed the previous frame time.

time3.label: Third frame time (s)
time3.description: Declared seconds since the series origin; must exceed the previous frame time.

width.label: Image width (px)
width.description: Width of every frame in pixels; the whole-frame rectangle covers it.

height.label: Image height (px)
height.description: Height of every frame in pixels.

x.label: Rectangle left (x)
x.description: Zero-based left pixel column of the rectangle.

y.label: Rectangle top (y)
y.description: Zero-based top pixel row of the rectangle.

innerWidth.label: Inner rectangle width
innerWidth.description: Pixel columns included, at least 1; x + width must not exceed the image width.

innerHeight.label: Inner rectangle height
innerHeight.description: Pixel rows included, at least 1; y + height must not exceed the image height.

size.label: Pixel size
size.description: Width and height of one pixel in the selected unit (square pixels); edit the document for rectangular pixels.

templates.requires: Java 11+ with jdk.compiler and ImageJ 1.54 ij.jar for native execution.

snippets.title: Intensity threshold window
snippets.description: Set the inclusive raw intensity window that defines particle pixels.

lower.label: Lowest foreground intensity
lower.description: Inclusive raw intensity; pixels at or above it (up to the upper bound) are particle pixels.

snippets.title: Pixel calibration
snippets.description: Declare the physical width and height of one pixel and the length unit used by every published measurement.

snippets.title: Particle area window
snippets.description: Keep only particles whose calibrated area lies within an inclusive window.

snippets.title: Particle connectivity
snippets.description: Choose whether corner-touching pixels join one particle; four connectivity also fills holes.

snippets.title: Exclude edge particles
snippets.description: Drop particles whose bounding box touches the image border, since they may be cut off.
